sources.title: Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct official model card
sources.evidence: Exact Instruct repository identifies Meta, Llama 4, nominal 109B total/17B activated parameters, 16 experts, text/image inputs and text/code outputs, BF16 weights, April 5 2025 release, and the Llama 4 Community License.

sources.title: The Llama 4 herd: The beginning of a new era of natively multimodal AI innovation
sources.evidence: Dated April 5 2025 announcement says Scout and Maverick are available to download that day and describes native multimodal early fusion. Scout has 16 experts. The alternating dense/MoE and 128-routed-expert example explicitly describes Maverick, so it is not transferred to Scout.

sources.title: Official model SKU definitions and sequence limits
sources.evidence: CoreModelId names Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct; max_seq_length explicitly returns 10485760 for that identifier, while the pretrained Scout identifier returns 262144.

sources.title: Llama 4 model cards and prompt formats
sources.evidence: Scout comparison column reports 109B total, 17B active, 16 experts and 10M nominal context. Documentation includes native zero-shot function calling and tool-response formats. It specifies text plus images in and text-only out; it does not define a separate thinking mode.

sources.title: Official Llama 4 MoE implementation
sources.evidence: MoE constructs routed experts plus a distinct shared expert, uses top-k router selection, and adds the shared-expert result to routed results. This is common implementation code, not an independently accessible Scout checkpoint configuration.

sources.title: Official Llama 4 architecture arguments
sources.evidence: MoEArgs defaults top_k to 1 and interleave_moe_layer_step to 1. Defaults document the reference implementation but are not proof that a gated checkpoint overrides neither setting.

sources.title: Official Llama 4 multimodal Transformer implementation
sources.evidence: Defines Transformer blocks, configurable MoE layer intervals, vision embeddings and a vision projection into token embeddings. Load hooks discard rope.freqs and extra-state entries, illustrating why storage metadata alone is not a complete learned-parameter audit.

sources.title: Original Scout Instruct checkpoint configuration (gated)
sources.evidence: Direct unauthenticated request returned HTTP 401 Unauthorized. No gate bypass or weight-shard download was attempted; exact checkpoint shape/tying/buffer reconciliation is unavailable in this audit.

sources.title: Public metadata for original Scout Instruct checkpoint
sources.evidence: Public API reports gated=manual, Llama4ForConditionalGeneration, the exact repository chat template including function calls, and a BF16 safetensors metadata total of 108641793536. That hosting metadata is not promoted to a verified complete learned-parameter count.

sources.title: Llama versioning, updates and migration
sources.evidence: Current first-party comparison explicitly labels Scout as 109B total/17B active, 16-expert multimodal MoE with nominal 10M context. General reasoning discussions do not identify a dedicated Scout thinking mode.

name.note: Uses the complete official variant name; 17B is the nominal active count and 16E identifies the expert variant.

developer.note: The model card explicitly names Meta as developer.

family.note: Llama 4 is within the catalog's Llama family.

release_date.note: Explicit model release date and same-day download announcement agree.

open_weights.note: BF16 weights are released for download under Meta's custom license; access conditions do not make weights closed.

license.note: Named custom community/commercial license, not an OSI open-source classification.

parameters_b.note: Retain Meta's nominal total in billions, including active and inactive experts. Do not replace it with 17B or an unreconciled hosting storage-element total; no exact complete checkpoint count is claimed.

active_parameters_b.note: Meta explicitly reports 17B active per token; this is a nominal published figure, not 109B divided by 16.

architecture.note: Autoregressive multimodal Transformer with early fusion and 16 experts. Reference code has routed experts plus a shared expert and top-1 routing by default; original config is gated, so exact per-layer overrides are not independently verified. Do not transfer Maverick's alternating-layer example to Scout.

context_window.note: Exact native Scout Instruct limit from Meta's SKU code: 10 × 1,048,576 tokens. The advertised 10M is rounded; the same source separately gives base Scout 262144. Provider deployment limits may be lower.

modalities.note: Supported native input/output modalities; code is text output. Video used in training does not by itself establish a separate supported video input API.

reasoning.note: Clears unsupported baseline false. Reviewed exact model card/template and current first-party comparison and deployment documentation; these demonstrate general reasoning tasks but do not explicitly disclose a dedicated thinking/reasoning mode or its absence.

tool_call.note: Official function-calling documentation and the exact repository's public chat template support tool definitions, assistant function calls and tool replies.

description.value: Instruction-tuned multimodal MoE with 109B total and 17B active parameters, text/image input, text output, tool calling, and a 10,485,760-token context.
description.note: Replaces vague agent/efficiency wording with directly supported variant specifications.

patch.name: Llama 4 Scout 17B 16E Instruct
patch.description: Instruction-tuned multimodal MoE with 109B total and 17B active parameters, text/image input, text output, tool calling, and a 10,485,760-token context.
patch.notes: Meta reports nominal 109B total and 17B active parameters. The exact Scout Instruct context is 10,485,760 tokens; pretrained Scout is a different 262,144-token variant. The original configuration is gated, so no precise complete tensor count or exact per-layer routing configuration is asserted. A dedicated reasoning mode is not disclosed in the reviewed primary documentation.

sources.label: Meta Llama 4 prompt and tool formats

summary: Confirmed nominal 109B total/17B active, 16-expert multimodal MoE, April 5 2025 release, custom Llama 4 license, open weights and native tool calling. Corrected context from decimal 10M to exact 10485760, completed the official name with 16E, and rewrote description. Cleared unsupported reasoning=false to null/undisclosed. Original config is gated; a complete tensor-derived count and exact checkpoint routing overrides remain unverified, while the published nominal sizes and MoE classification are verified.
